derivation: amendment A12: absolute means scheme plus authority; '//beta.example/b' has authority but no scheme, so it is `hreflang_relative_href`, and A4 stops it contributing to self-reference, reciprocity or external target.

<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="//beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
